main_idea: PivotRL raised Qwen3.5-9B’s τ³-Banking pass@5 from 11.3% to 17.5%.
ideas: PivotRL improves task success on τ³-Banking.
The method used 50 solved teacher trajectories and profiled 193 pivot states.
Fewer examples can produce more capable agents.
summary: The chart is clear, but the vague headline, long subtitle, decorative branding, and method-count footer add clutter.
